finalText:
Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

**Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` with pool size still 20.** Every request took its own connection. The pool saturated in 37 seconds.

Impact ran `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z` and is still open at log end. 530 of 636 requests failed, 83%. On-call was paged 67 minutes late.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Watch `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` stop and `waiting` drop to 0.

The doc also records what I ruled out and one loose end: worker job time drifts 200ms to 2324ms, unrelated.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`.
